source.author: verg
source.text: Sic ait, et geminum pugnae proponit honorem, victori velatum auro vittisque iuvencum, ensem atque insignem galeam solacia victo.
source.text_original: Sic ait, et geminum pugnae proponit honorem, / victori velatum auro vittisque iuvencum, / ensem atque insignem galeam solacia victo.
source.text_english: So he speaks, and sets forth a double prize for the contest: for the victor, a bullock decked with gold and fillets; for the vanquished, a sword and a conspicuous helmet as consolation.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vestris egomet tune vellera templis illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_original: vestris egomet tune vellera templis / illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni / colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_english: Shall I myself then give those fleeces to your temples? Their father shall give his neck to the gilded fire, and snowy flocks shall surround the altars.
